environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the 'architectural' nature of the larval case; the adult has soft, moth-like hairy wings; earthy but rich textures.

visual_logic.composition: A focus on the riverbed. In the center, a Caddisfly larva is visible inside its 'mobile home'—a tube made of tiny purple mudstone fragments and bits of fossilized wood. An adult caddisfly rests on a dry rock just above the water line.
visual_logic.ground: A mosaic of tiny stones, sand, and organic debris at the bottom of a clear, bubbling stream.
visual_logic.lighting: Cool, soft-focus morning light that highlights the 'wet' texture of the river stones.
